scope: Local macOS arm64 Store custody for administrator telephone replacement policy, verified provisioned destination, independent current dial/route-owner authority, immutable policy/route reservation and once-only preparation. No telephone transport or provider submission was performed.
implemented: Host-only TelephoneReplacementPolicy validates a bounded trunk reference, SIP authority, explicit answer/DTMF digits and 1-60 second preparation deadline; there is no default confirmation digit.

The exact verified telephone Endpoint selects the E.164 number, matching trunk secret reference and current route owner. Only the configured authority derives the SIP URI; payload-extension addresses/digits cannot replace policy.
Preparation and begin require independent current sip_dial plus connection.replace, original source/retained physical grants and the same merged route-owner identity fence.

Immutable reservation records the complete policy and resolved route. Same intention replays original IDs/deadline; changed trunk/authority/digits/timeout conflicts. Endpoint or route-owner revocation refuses begin.
Unknown managed preparation retains attempt 1 and cannot reserve another effect, Connection or legacy SIP leg. This does not assert an external call was submitted or undone.
The route-owner regression uses a distinct non-participant identity, separate from caller/source/retained, and exercises protected public revocation and writer contention.
unqualified: Canonical runtime still rejects non-QUIC replacement before reservation. No server telephone adapter or public callback route is installed by this component.
Telephone allocation/start and stable external receipts, actual call submission, attributed answer/DTMF, media readiness, movement and independent established adapter lifetime remain required.
Telephone no-answer/voicemail/rejected-confirmation/timeout/cancel/late-event/unknown-submission/restart recovery without redial remains required.
Native actual media/HTTP integration and full Store/Core/workspace suites were not rerun; their prior reports are historical.
Retargeted selector/private-context churn, Linux/browser/remote/provider/performance profiles, independent acceptance and publication remain required.
diagnostics: An initial run exposed outdated telephone fixture assumptions: collaboration credentials already include sip_dial, a manually verified fixture retained revision zero, and the older digits-only expectation now requires complete callback policy. Those fixtures were corrected without weakening permission or confirmation requirements. A separate route-owner fixture was added so existing source identity fences cannot satisfy that regression accidentally.
